creole-recursive-character-hiding: The private hide/restore encoding and ten hidden syntax characters match pinned CharHidder exactly. Backslash-tilde is consumed before matching; nested boundaries preserve the hidden stream. No fixture-dependent branches or unexplained new constants were found.

14/20 fresh whole outputs pass. All five overlapping delimiter families, double/triple tildes, start/end nested escapes, and activity/state/note/class-member consumers have exact text runs and pass whole output. WBS composed/leaf/depth/side escape control also passes. No double-unescaping was observed in these controls.

hide_parameter_size and hide_parameter_color disprove integrated selection parity. Splitter.fontSizePattern requires digits; fontColorPattern requires #hex or optional-# word before >. After hiding, ~# becomes U+E023 and cannot match Java color grammar. Rust handle_tag uses starts_with(color:/size:), consumes invalid commands anyway, and copies the hidden parameter into Style.fill. Java renders literal X<color:#123456>fir</color>Y; Rust renders fir with fill U+E023123456. All three malformed-but-valid-diagram size inputs collapse from Java literal lines into styled atoms. These whole cases already failed before; the candidate additionally changes atom boundaries and hidden attribute bytes.

hide_closing_capture fixes the escaped closing-tag text exactly, but its four-line note body is one pixel short through unchanged per-line flooring in sequence.rs. This is a whole failure, not a waiver.

hide_link_target and hide_link_label pass whole output including target/tooltip attributes. Java itself carries hidden characters into URL fields; matching private-use characters there are not a Rust-only leak. Raw link labels are atom text, not recursively styled: both implementations now agree. No URL-recursion correctness beyond these cases is claimed.

hide_raw_regions retains existing unsupported <plain> reset and false <code> activation. Java FontStyle recognizes plain; it has no corresponding code style command here. Rust handle_tag handles code as monospace and leaves plain literal. Quoted monospace escaping improves; the whole combined input fails. hide_unicode_sprite and residual_omega_only retain font/fallback width failures, with matching escaped content.
New and old failures remain executable. Full raw reproduction confirms no pass losses/new process errors/new panics; existing URL/italic/legacy, PLAIN, note and font obligations are not accepted.
creole-parameter-command-flush: Java StripeSimple.modifyStripe flushes pending text around every selected command, including atomless size/color bodies; getAtoms adds a base-style space only for an atomless actual stripe. The new private barriers in handle_tag size/color mirror that invariant and are removed before paint.

7/8 fresh whole outputs pass; all 8 have byte-exact Java text-run counts, content, style attributes, widths and baselines. Activity/state/note/class-member leading, trailing, adjacent and nested empty commands plus nonempty siblings pass. Multiline WBS leaf/composed labels, depth/sides and actual atomless stripes pass without any WBS source or geometry edit.

flush_eol_nested fails whole output despite exact text atoms: its four-line folded note is 70 px high in Rust versus 71 in Java. Rust note_rendered_height sums individually floored line heights; Java ComponentRoseNote casts total block height plus margins. It also fails before. Under the explicit whole-output rule, bounded flush support cannot become acceptance.

Prior html_parameters now has separate q/r/s atoms and exactly one remaining difference: size-31 italic baseline 78.3672 versus 95.7695. It remains a failure assigned to the separate sequence work, not a waiver or combined-correctness assertion.

WBS leaf arithmetic was not retuned. Source, caller, font and geometry hashes are unchanged. Old-order warning chrome and wbs_shape_color remain failures, while s_shape_color_literals is a verified passing whitespace-neighbour control.
